alt: L.A. Care Health Plan Grievance Resolution Letter dated January 5, 2026, confirming payment of the LAFD ambulance bill.
full_text: L.A. Care Health Plan, Grievance and Appeals Department. Date: January 5, 2026. Patient Name: Nicolas Hernandez. Case/Claim Reference: [REDACTED]54. Dear Mr. Hernandez: This letter is to confirm the resolution of your billing grievance regarding emergency transportation. L.A. Care Health Plan has successfully authorized and processed payment in full for the City of Los Angeles Fire Department emergency transport invoice in the amount of $1,942.00. There is zero member financial liability for this transport under the processed claim. Sincerely, Grievance and Appeals Department, L.A. Care Health Plan.
summary: L.A. Care Health Plan Grievance Resolution Letter dated January 5, 2026, confirming the plan paid the full $1,942.00 LAFD ambulance bill under claim [REDACTED]54, resulting in zero member liability.
